import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power_mod(b, e, m):
    x = 1
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            x = (b * x) % m
        b = (b * b) % m
        e >>= 1
    return x

def compute_answer(n, m, L, R, mod):
    inv2 = power_mod(2, mod - 2, mod)
    diff = R - L + 1
    p1 = diff // 2
    p2 = diff - p1
    nm = n * m
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        return power_mod(diff, nm, mod)
    else:
        pp1 = diff
        pp2 = abs(p1 - p2)
        opt1 = power_mod(pp1, nm, mod)
        opt2 = power_mod(pp2, nm, mod)
        opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod
        opt = (opt * inv2) % mod
        return opt

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])
    ans = compute_answer(n, m, L, R, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
